_about: Public-domain Hermann Cremer (1834-1903, Greifswald) in English for the Word Hoard: the Biblico-Theological Lexicon of New Testament Greek, tr. D. W. Simon and William Urwick (Edinburgh, 1872), Beyond the Grave, tr. Samuel T. Lowrie (New York, 1886), and A Reply to Harnack on the Essence of Christianity, tr. Bernhard Pick (1903), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 31 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

cremer-lexicon-nt-greek: Biblico-Theological Lexicon of New Testament Greek, tr. D. W. Simon and William Urwick (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, MDCCCLXXII)
cremer-beyond-the-grave: Beyond the Grave, tr. Samuel T. Lowrie, introduction by A. A. Hodge (New York: Harper & Brothers, 1886)
cremer-reply-to-harnack: A Reply to Harnack on the Essence of Christianity, tr. Bernhard Pick (New York and London: Funk & Wagnalls, 1903)

_alternates.cremer-lexicon-later: The 1878 second edition (Urwick), 1886-1887 third and 1895 fourth English editions with supplement
_alternates.cremer-copies: Other copies of Beyond the Grave (1886) and the Reply (1903)
